column1: # Manual function ownership labels for tools/fndb.sh (never overwritten by the classifier).
#   lib:   library for thirdparty/crt (std, rapidjson, sparsehash, Luau, AK, ...); 'remedy' for Remedy code
# `tools/fndb.sh owner-eval` classifies these with overrides disabled to measure precision.

column4: mimalloc 2.1.2 _mi_page_malloc: pops page->free (+0x10), ++used (+0x18), zeroes xblock_size (+0x1c) unless free_is_zero (+0xf bit0); falls back to _mi_malloc_generic. Layout matches third_party/mimalloc types.h
mimalloc 2.1.2 _mi_free_generic(segment, page, is_local, p): out-of-line path of the mi_free fast path inlined in Remedy code (segment thread_id at +0x100, page flags +0xe)
mimalloc 2.1.2 mi_heap_malloc_aligned (inlined _zero_aligned_at chain): size<=128 && align<=size fast path via _mi_page_malloc, MI_ALIGNMENT_MAX 16 MB, sets page has_aligned (flags |= 2)
mimalloc 2.1.2 _mi_page_retire(page): called by the inlined mi_free fast path when page->used reaches 0
mimalloc 2.1.2 _mi_malloc_generic(heap, size, zero, huge_alignment): slow path of _mi_page_malloc and the aligned allocator

mimalloc 2.1.2 option init (mi_option_init): references "mimalloc_%s" env-option strings; option-name table matches v2.1.2 exactly (limit_os_alloc, decommit_extend_delay present; 2.1.4 options absent)
